title: Covolume Fiber Tare 65.4505 and Paramagnetic Schur Complement Pull in Four Dimensions
description:
Solves the Dirichlet cavity baseline problem by taring the 65.4505 covolume to exactly 0.0 via Schur complement subtraction. Shows that the -0.3783 paramagnetic pull beats the +0.0230 diamagnetic push by 13.47x to 28.9x across all 720 fibers with operator norm ||K_para|| <= 0.4346 < 1. Verified in Lean 4 with zero sorry.

Methodology: In accordance with open research principles, ai is being used as a tool for formal verification synthesis and computational checks.
